description: Detection-power analysis: is the human non-detection of GSDMD-TMEM106A a species difference or a depth limitation?
code:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats

# Counts extracted from the primary paper's own source data (PMC13686932 supplementary archive,
# Source Data Fig.1b = mouse BMDM chRNA reads; Supplementary Table 11 = human MDM chRNA reads).
mouse_chreads, mouse_gt = 36826, 1
human_chreads, human_gt = 1441, 0
f = mouse_gt/mouse_chreads
exp_h = f*human_chreads
p_detect = 1-np.exp(-exp_h)
# exact binomial one-sided p for "human rate is lower than mouse rate"
pbin = stats.binomtest(human_gt, human_chreads, f, alternative="less").pvalue
print(f"mouse Gsdmd-Tmem106a: {mouse_gt} read / {mouse_chreads} chimeric reads  (freq {f:.2e}; rank {30390}/{30390}, singleton)")
print(f"human GSDMD-TMEM106A: {human_gt} reads / {human_chreads} chimeric reads  ({mouse_chreads/human_chreads:.1f}x shallower)")
print(f"expected human reads if the chimera exists at the mouse frequency = {exp_h:.3f}")
print(f"P(detecting >=1 human read | same frequency)                      = {p_detect*100:.1f}%")
print(f"one-sided binomial p for a true human deficit                     = {pbin:.3f}  (not significant)")
print("=> the human non-detection is uninformative: absence of detection power, not a species difference.")

# how deep would the human library need to be?
need=[(pw, -np.log(1-pw)/f) for pw in (0.5,0.8,0.95)]
print("\nchimeric reads needed in a human library for:")
for pw,n in need: print(f"   {int(pw*100)}% power to see >=1 read : {n:,.0f}  ({n/human_chreads:.0f}x current depth)")

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12,4.4))
ax=axes[0]
ax.bar(["mouse BMDM","human MDM"],[mouse_chreads,human_chreads],color=["#4c72b0","#c2403d"],width=.55)
for i,(v,g) in enumerate([(mouse_chreads,"1 Gsdmd-Tmem106a read"),(human_chreads,"0 GSDMD-TMEM106A reads")]):
    ax.text(i,v*1.05,f"{v:,}\n{g}",ha="center",fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel("total chimeric reads in long-read direct RNA-seq")
ax.set_ylim(0,mouse_chreads*1.35); ax.set_title("Dataset depth, PMID 42686912 source data",fontsize=10)

ax=axes[1]
depths=np.logspace(2.5,6.5,300)
ax.semilogx(depths,1-np.exp(-f*depths),color="#4c72b0",lw=2)
ax.axvline(human_chreads,color="#c2403d",ls="--",lw=1.5)
ax.axhline(p_detect,color="#c2403d",ls=":",lw=1.2)
ax.plot([human_chreads],[p_detect],"o",color="#c2403d")
ax.text(human_chreads*1.3,p_detect+0.04,f"human dataset:\n{p_detect*100:.0f}% power",color="#c2403d",fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlabel("chimeric reads sequenced"); ax.set_ylabel("P(detect $\\geq$1 chimeric read)")
ax.set_title("Power to detect a human GSDMD-TMEM106A at the mouse frequency",fontsize=10)
ax.set_ylim(0,1.02)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
